Hey! Built a small game teaching number theory (divisibility → congruences → GCD/Bézout → linear congruences & CRT).
Heads up: I'm not a mathematician or teacher, and I used AI for some of the hint/intro text. Proofs are all Lean-checked, but the wording might have rough spots — please call them out.
https://github.com/k88-b/NumberTheoryGame
https://adam.math.hhu.de/#/g/k88-b/NumberTheoryGame

Nice, finally a chance for me to learn some number theory.

One weird thing I noticed in Level 2 / 11. It introduces have, which lets you prove false statements with ring, e.g., have : a = 42 := by ring seems to work and add that hypothesis to the context. The level itself apparently can't be solved using such false hypotheses but it lets you rw with them and is generally quite confusing.

This is actually a known visual bug on the server side, so it isn't an issue with the game itself. What's happening is that when a line contains := by ... and there is an error in the tactic (like ring failing to prove a = 42), the error message sometimes gets lost by the server. It silently fills the gap with a sorry, which makes it look like the proof was completed successfully and adds the false hypothesis to your context. (If you toggle "editor mode" in the top right corner, you will actually be able to see the red error on that line)
In reality, the have tactic strictly requires a valid mathematical proof. Once the server issue is patched, it won't be possible to add false statements to the context, because Lean will properly reject the invalid proof and show an error.
I've also gone ahead and updated the documentation for the have tactic to make its usage clearer. Let me know if you run into any other weird behavior
AFAIK there is nobody working on the server right now, so game creators have to work around any limitations in the software.

kostya88 and I have been talking in DMs about this, thought I put the code snippet here, too. Currently, server development and bugfixing is on a minimum as the available time needs to go into addressing the outdated dependency stack which makes it almost impossible to keep the project updated. So for the short-term it's probably better if game creators work with the state as is.

Regarding this issue, it should be possible to prevent the game from using := like this:

-- Workaround: lean4game doesn't show errors inside the proof term of  `have _ := _`,
-- so we disable it
syntax (name := gameHave) "have" letConfig letDecl : tactic

macro_rules (kind := gameHave)
  | `(tactic| have $_:letId $_* : $_ :=%$tk $_) => do
    Lean.Macro.throwErrorAt tk "`have _ := _` cannot be used in this game. \
    There is a bug which would not display errors inside the proof term. \
    Please use `have _` instead!"
    `(tactic| skip)

(this snippet goes into Metadata.lean, or any other place which is imported in all level files)
Thanks to Jon for the solution! I've updated the game, and this syntax is no longer supported
Can you guys add the repository link to the README of the main game? I wanna file a bug report.

Short problem: "The theorem/definition 'dvd_antisymm' is not available in this game!" in level 10 of world 2.
Due to the limited tactics proof something like push_neq or cases is not available so i cannot circumvent this theorem by using a contradiction.
After repeadetly trying "exact Int.dvd_antisymm hd1 hd2 d12 d21" it works now

Sorry for the late reply. Thanks for reporting this. I've updated the game, so dvd_antisymm should now work directly without the Int. prefix.
